cars.summary: The original GT86 revived the accessible, driver-focused Toyota rear-drive sports coupe through an engineering collaboration with Subaru. Its low-mounted naturally aspirated boxer engine, Toyota D-4S dual injection, carefully developed manual gearbox and Torsen differential make it a modern analogue-sports-car landmark rather than another ordinary coupe trim.

Base road car: optional Circuit Pack Torsen differentials/forged wheels/tuning, Japan RS, later 2024 engine/automatic and competition-car data are excluded.
cars.summary: The original GR Yaris is a modern rally-bred road-car landmark, developed with Tommi Mäkinen Racing around a bespoke three-door body and a combined GA-B/GA-C platform. Its compact turbocharged three-cylinder engine, carbon-composite roof and GR-Four drivetrain revived the engineering spirit of road homologation specials beyond an ordinary Yaris performance trim.

cars.generation: Tenth-generation Civic FK8 original Type R road series
cars.variant: Type R — original 2017 French six-speed road specification
cars.specification_market: Original 2017 Honda Motor Europe French road launch account and technical section. Native European 235 kW / 320 ch and 400 Nm are separate from US 306-hp notation. New FK8 chassis sections are used, not historical FK2 paragraphs. No current lap-record superlative, disputed seat-count line, GT-only equipment, facelift, Limited Edition or FL5 data.
cars.summary: The FK8 Civic Type R is a major front-drive performance-car development, combining a turbo VTEC engine and manual transmission with a revised dual-axis front suspension, new multi-link rear layout, adaptive damping and functional aerodynamics. It represents a distinct Type R chassis generation, with a complete road-and-track engineering package beyond an engine tune or visual edition.
